title: utilityProcess child exits before its first message after a version upgrade
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

The child starts and sends its ready message as it did in Electron 41.

### Actual Behavior

The only captured output is:

```text
utility child starting
child-process-gone { type: "Utility", reason: "crashed", exitCode: 139 }
Native stack:
  0 Electron Framework utility_process_bootstrap + 172
  1 Electron Framework node::Start + 64
  2 libsystem_pthread thread_start + 8
```

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

The parent uses utilityProcess.fork; neither the parent module nor worker module is included.
